summary: Comprehensive architecture audit and implementation blueprint for integrating a legitimate global music catalogue into SongVerse. Evaluates B2B commercial music licensing providers (Feed.fm, 7digital/Songtradr, Jamendo, Audius, and MusicBrainz), establishes rights-cleared timed excerpt rules for players without Spotify or Apple Music subscriptions, details schema separation for metadata, audio, and licensing, and maps the migration path while preserving the four-level game engine and skip mechanic.
